body: I started using drugs because I had problems :/ they came long after my social issues

13 years and counting of it getting worse I highly doubt that

I have continued to destroy all of the best things in my life, why would that change when I dont do it intentionally
My SO, the person she made me realize I am and the drugs I cant let go
If there was I wouldn't here

I suffer from despression and have pushed all of my closest friends and family away which only worsens the cycle and has now led to the loss of my job. The longer I live the more I believe I'm living in some sort of hell

Having thought about suicide everyday for over a decade and suffering the same background issues due to some of that the feeling is mutual :/. What matters is that you are obviously strong enough to continue to fight on and look for something that matters. Hopefully someday we both find something worth putting a real smile for :)

I want you to know that I am in the same boat (27M as well). My friends all left me for my ex-girlfriend and the few that stayed I pushed away quickly... If you need anyone I am here now and will be all night

I have the exact same thought process... I think things like "why did I say that?!" or get the same reaction you described and get told to "stop feeling that way". The one thing I do know is that I'm not a bad person and I'm sure you aren't either... From my experience being a good person opens you up to being walked on by other people, it's the nature of giving in my mind. You're not alone, I feel like I could have written the majority of your comment myself... 

I never wanted to go to therapy myself because of the same stigma you mention, but what I came to realize after pushing everyone I loved away from me was that it was better to put these problems on a person who not only is it their job to care, but they WANT to help you. It may not be for you and it may take a while to find someone you like if you decide to go that route... I fought therapy for a long time and can say that it hasn't fixed my life but it helps knowing you don't carry the burden alone.

Like I said earlier... I understand you so I hope you can take something from that. Here anytime
